connections.roadNetwork: Reuse and extend vanilla road/navigation graph; no disconnected island scene.
connections.coordinates: All positions and nav links require in-game capture.

gameplay.shops: in-person and Hyland Network mobile order channels share the same native catalog/inventory
gameplay.realEstate: all purchasable businesses listed through the existing Realtor flow
gameplay.police: native dispatch/spawn/response system registered for Harborline

performance.streamingAndDistanceActivation: Use only if supported by the native world/NPC systems; do not invent a parallel streaming system.

mapIntegration.status: requires in-game map/scene survey and verified native map-region hook

buildings.fallback: S1MAPI BuildingBuilder may create structure geometry only; it does not automatically make the shell a native Building, Property, Shop or functional business.
buildings.navigation: colliders plus verified navmesh/NavigationBuilder doorway links; NPCs must traverse entrances and use native StayInBuilding schedules

regionIdentity.rule: Do not invent Region.Harborline. Keep Harborline as a named subdistrict in Docks; verify its coordinates, map bounds, navigation and police coverage against the native Docks area.
